name: AI Content Marketing for Small Business
nameZh: 小企业 AI 内容营销实战
timeLength: 13 independent 60-minute units delivered across two days
description: Build the business and audience brief, Brand Kit, visual templates, poster and basic merchandise, produce social content and short video, then use AI to manage projects and company execution.
courseObjective: Build the brand and design foundation, a 30-day social plan, publishable assets, three short videos, and an AI project and company task system for marketing, sales, customer follow-up and daily operations.
suitable: Owners, founders and marketers with a real product, service, event, store or personal brand who want usable marketing assets without coding.
features: Brand and design completed in the first three hours

phases.name: Stage 1 — Business, Audience & Brand
phases.summary: Finish the business inputs, audience signals, brand rules and first design assets in three hours

lessons.title: Understand the Business, Audience and Current Brand
lessons.description: Organise real business material, extract customer questions, motivations and objections from genuine feedback, and audit the current logo, colour, type, imagery and recurring inconsistencies.
knowledge: Separate public facts, internal information, customer privacy and prohibited claims
Extract customer language, questions, motivations and objections from real material
Identify current brand assets and inconsistencies
Package the business, audience and brand inputs into a reusable brief

steps.title: Import business inputs
steps.description: Collect the offer, pricing, FAQs, proof, logo, images and existing content.

steps.title: Extract audience signals
steps.description: Use real comments, enquiries or de-identified sales conversations.

steps.title: Audit the current brand
steps.description: Inventory visual assets, usage rules and recurring inconsistencies.

steps.title: Finish the input brief
steps.description: Confirm facts, privacy, audience and brand inputs are ready for production.

lessons.title: Build the AI Brand Kit and Visual Templates
lessons.description: Turn brand voice, colour, typography, imagery, composition, CTA and prohibited rules into an executable Design Source of Truth, then create reusable social templates.
knowledge: Convert brand assets into clear, executable visual rules
Define boundaries for logo, colour, type, photography and illustration
Build templates for the most-used social formats
Find logo, colour, type and composition drift with one consistency check

steps.title: Lock the brand rules
steps.description: Confirm voice, colour, type, imagery, composition and prohibited treatments.

steps.title: Build the Design Source of Truth
steps.description: Create a reusable brand and design specification.

steps.title: Create visual templates
steps.description: Build the layouts and components used most often by the business.

steps.title: Run the consistency check
steps.description: Check logo, colour, type, composition and CTA.

lessons.title: Create the Poster, Print Asset and Basic Merchandise
lessons.description: Use one real product or promotion to create a key visual and digital poster, then extend it into one flyer, menu, voucher, packaging or merchandise item and check the handoff files.
knowledge: Turn product or promotional information into an executable design brief
Extend one key visual into digital, print and basic merchandise
Set dimensions and safe areas for platforms, printers and suppliers
Export editable, printable or handoff-ready files

steps.title: Write the design brief
steps.description: Confirm the audience, hierarchy, CTA, specifications and required brand elements.

steps.title: Create the key visual and poster
steps.description: Generate, select and correct product, people, logo and text issues.

steps.title: Extend one physical asset
steps.description: Create one flyer, menu, voucher, packaging or merchandise item.

steps.title: Check the handoff
steps.description: Verify dimensions, bleed, safe areas, links, QR codes and file names.

deliverables: One print or basic merchandise asset

phases.name: Stage 2 — Social Media Production
phases.summary: Build a 30-day system from real audience questions and produce platform-native copy and visuals

lessons.title: Build a 30-Day Social Media System
lessons.description: Choose platforms the business can sustain, build content pillars and a 30-day calendar, and complete the first 12 posts around genuine customer questions, evidence and CTA.
knowledge: Choose primary platforms from the goal, audience and production capacity
Turn audience signals into education, proof, product, behind-the-scenes and conversion pillars
Assign format, evidence, CTA, assets and owner across 30 days
Remove filler, repeated structures and unsupported claims

steps.title: Choose platforms and pillars
steps.description: Set the primary platforms, content goals and five content pillars.

steps.title: Build the 30-day calendar
steps.description: Map audience questions to dates, formats, proof, CTA and owners.

steps.title: Finish 12 posts
steps.description: Complete the hooks, body copy, CTA and visual briefs.

steps.title: Check facts and repetition
steps.description: Remove fabrication, filler and mechanical repetition, then record revisions.

lessons.title: Create Once, Publish Natively Across Platforms
lessons.description: Adapt one master content item into genuinely native platform versions, then use the Brand Kit and templates from the first three hours to produce a carousel, images, stories and cover.
knowledge: Rewrite hooks, body copy, CTA, tags and pacing for each platform
Decide what can be reused and what must be rebuilt
Use one template system to preserve brand consistency
Check dimensions, crop-safe areas, text density and mobile readability

steps.title: Select the master content
steps.description: Choose one core item suitable for platform adaptation.

steps.title: Write native platform versions
steps.description: Complete hooks, body copy, CTA and tags for selected platforms.

steps.title: Create platform visuals
steps.description: Use the Brand Kit and templates to create a carousel, images, stories and cover.

steps.title: Run platform QA
steps.description: Check dimensions, copy, CTA, crops and brand consistency.

phases.name: Stage 3 — Short Video
phases.summary: Finish three vertical videos with different jobs in three hours

lessons.title: Produce Publishable Short Videos with AI
lessons.description: Produce three videos for education, proof or promotion, moving from hooks, scripts and storyboards to visuals, captions, covers, exports and pre-publish QA.
knowledge: Choose hooks, structures, duration and CTA for different video jobs
Break scripts into shots, on-screen text, assets and sound requirements
Use the Brand Kit across captions, covers and visuals
Check the opening, audio, facts, rights and export specifications

steps.title: Define three video jobs
steps.description: Set the hook and CTA for education, proof or promotion videos.

steps.title: Finish scripts and storyboards
steps.description: Specify shots, narration, on-screen text, assets, sound and captions.

steps.title: Assemble three short videos
steps.description: Finish visuals, captions, sound, covers and vertical exports.

steps.title: Run pre-publish QA
steps.description: Check the opening, brand, facts, rights, audio and export settings.

phases.name: Stage 4 — AI Project & Business Management
phases.summary: Turn AI into a practical project coordinator and company task-management assistant

lessons.title: Build the Project and Company Task System with AI
lessons.description: Use AI to break down marketing, sales, customer follow-up and daily operations, then set priorities, owners, due dates, dependencies, states and completion criteria without teaching Scrum job titles.
knowledge: Turn business outcomes into finishable, testable project tasks
Use AI to suggest priorities from value, dependencies, capacity and risk
Give every task one owner, state, due date and Definition of Done
Build one practical Company Task Board for a small business

steps.title: Choose one real project
steps.description: Use a marketing, sales, customer-delivery or daily-operations project.

steps.title: Use AI to break down and prioritise tasks
steps.description: Generate tasks, dependencies, risks and priority suggestions, then confirm them with the owner.

steps.title: Build the Company Task Board
steps.description: Set owners, states, due dates, dependencies and completion criteria.

steps.title: Check ownership and the execution path
steps.description: Remove vague tasks and confirm one owner and next action for every item.

lessons.title: Use AI to Drive Delivery, Follow-ups and Reviews
lessons.description: Use AI to turn meetings, messages and progress updates into actions, surface blockers, produce a weekly report and prepare the next operating cycle using truthful task states.
knowledge: Extract tasks, owners, due dates, decisions and open questions from meetings and messages
Generate progress updates, blocker lists and weekly reports from real task states
Use Review and Retro to decide what to stop, change, continue or scale
Package the effective management steps as a reusable AI workflow

steps.title: Extract actions from meetings and messages
steps.description: Create tasks, owners, due dates, decisions and open questions.

steps.title: Update progress and blockers
steps.description: Update the task board from real states and mark missing information.

steps.title: Generate the weekly report and review
steps.description: Summarise completions, delays, risks and next steps, then make Stop, Change, Continue and Scale decisions.

steps.title: Package the business management workflow
steps.description: Save meeting templates, update rules, checks and next-cycle tasks.

pausedExtensions.name: Complete Campaign Kit
pausedExtensions.note: Not part of the 13-hour core course. It may return later as a separate campaign workshop.
